scenes.narration: Cần Thơ mưa phùr lạnh, cậu bé tí hon đạp chiếc xe cũ kỹ qua những con hẻm ẩm ướt.
scenes.narration_en: Can Tho misty rain falls; the tiny boy pedals his rusty bike through damp alleyways.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of a small Vietnamese boy in worn-out clothes riding an old bicycle, heavy grey morning mist over Can Tho canal houses, soft diffused lighting, no text on image.

scenes.narration: Đột nhiên xe gãy giữa đường, vé số rơi ra đầy đất khi cậu bàng hoàng nhìn chiếc xích lô lạ.
scenes.narration_en: Suddenly the bike breaks; lottery tickets scatter as he stares blankly at a strange cycle rickshaw nearby.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of the boy in shock standing amidst scattered blue paper tickets, broken bicycle frame on wet pavement, dramatic low-angle lighting highlighting raindrops.

scenes.narration: Cậu chạy theo người lạ nhưng họ lắc đầu; cậu quay lại nhặt từng tờ vé còn sót trong nước mưa.
scenes.narration_en: He chases strangers who shake their heads no; he returns to gather remaining tickets from the rainwater puddles.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of boy running frantically through Can Tho streets, blurred background figures shaking hands negatively, golden hour light breaking through dark clouds.

scenes.narration: Người quen dẫn cậu đến cơ quan công an; họ tìm lại chiếc xe và trả lại những vé số còn nguyên.
scenes.narration_en: An acquaintance leads him to the police station; they find his bike and return the intact lottery tickets.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot inside a simple Vietnamese office, warm sunlight streaming through window onto boy holding restored bicycle and ticket roll, emotional expressions.

scenes.narration: Vừa kịp cổng trường thi mưa tạnh; cậu nắm chặt vé số mới như giữ lấy ước mơ bay xa.
scenes.narration_en: Just in time for the exam gate as rain stops; he grips new tickets tightly like holding dreams of flying away.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of boy standing at school entrance under clear blue sky, sunlight illuminating his hopeful face and bicycle, soft focus on colorful ticket papers.

scenes.narration: Bài thi bắt đầu với nụ cười rạng rỡ; hành trình nhỏ bé hôm nay sẽ viết nên tương lai lớn lao.
scenes.narration_en: Exam begins with radiant smile; today's small journey will write a grand future ahead for him now.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of boy entering examination hall door, bright natural light filling frame, shallow depth of field showing smiling face and bicycle lock on shoulder.
